displayDescription: An isometric idea block lands on a night-slate slab, links extrude along the iso axes and teal pulses light four connected parts.
styleRenderer: Three.js WebGLRenderer (r186, bundled locally to iso-scene.js with esbuild)
THREE.OrthographicCamera at true isometric orientation (camera on (1,1,1), 1 world unit = 1 px)
motionEngine: GSAP paused timeline (single owner of all animated values; WebGL redraws from that state on update and hf-seek)
audioDescription: Silent. No music, voiceover or sound effects.
limitations: Shading is flat and authored per face (MeshBasicMaterial with a fixed screen-left light convention), not physically lit; contact shadows are offset translucent planes, not computed shadows.
Teal pulse glow is an additive sprite halo, not real emission or bloom.

Background #0E181E and the slate/strata shades are a scene-dependent choice informed by BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json (matte neutral masses, one teal system hue, warm terracotta secondary); no source subject, branding or wording was copied.
Blender was not used, per the user's instruction.
Not rendered or browser-tested by the agent; the host runs check and render.
